  situation: Replacing a failed condenser fan motor on a Corvane CX unit.
  action: Also replaces the run capacitor at no charge even if in spec.
  reason: 2014-16 batch capacitors degrade fast with a new motor.
  scope: Only serials CX14-CX16.

KNOWLEDGE UNITS:
KU003: WHEN replacing a CX fan motor THEN swap the run capacitor free. WHY: old batch caps fail within ~60 days. SCOPE: -
